C6_VERIFICATION_BURDEN.definition: V(G,X,R) = number of concrete source occurrences dereferenced to verify consumer requirement
C6_VERIFICATION_BURDEN.falsifier: verification burden assigned from |R| rather than trace

C7_METADATA_BURDEN.definition: M(G,R) = number of derived-structure elements inspected during candidate generation
C7_METADATA_BURDEN.falsifier: metadata traversal omitted because no source occurrence touched

C8_BUILD_BURDEN.definition: B(G,X) = number of concrete source occurrences inspected during construction
C8_BUILD_BURDEN.falsifier: build work omitted from end-to-end accounting

C9_FULL_VALIDATION_BURDEN.definition: F(G,X) = number of concrete source occurrences inspected during FULL validation
C9_FULL_VALIDATION_BURDEN.falsifier: BOUND validation counted as zero-cost FULL

C10_EXCLUSION_SHARPNESS.falsifier: epsilon interpreted as utility without C3

C11_FALSE_CANDIDATE_AMPLIFICATION.falsifier: false candidates omitted because outcome correct

C12_PLACEMENT_DEPENDENCE.definition: rho_P(G,R) = range of V across permitted reorderings
C12_PLACEMENT_DEPENDENCE.falsifier: source-size change used instead of placement change

C13_REUSE_HORIZON.definition: q_valid(G,X,W) = number of queries served by same valid structure

C14_FRESHNESS_DOMAIN.definition: FreshDomain(G_X) = source states for which G_X remains valid
C14_FRESHNESS_DOMAIN.falsifier: stale structure accepted because outcome correct

C15_UPDATE_INVALIDATION_RADIUS.definition: InvRadius(G,deltaX) = derived-structure elements invalidated by source update
C15_UPDATE_INVALIDATION_RADIUS.falsifier: radius inferred from repair rather than validity

C16_ASSURANCE_REQUIREMENT.definition: States: FULLY_REVALIDATED, BOUND_TO_FROZEN_BUILD, UNVERIFIED, INVALID, STALE

C18_MECHANISM_DISTINCTNESS.definition: Structural axes: addressing type, organisation, exclusion, position relationship, granularity
C18_MECHANISM_DISTINCTNESS.falsifier: new experiment admitted because class name changed

C19_CANDIDATE_SET_OBSERVABILITY.definition: Candidate set is observable iff complete set can be enumerated before verification
C19_CANDIDATE_SET_OBSERVABILITY.falsifier: selectivity claimed when candidate set cannot be enumerated

C20_COST_OBSERVABILITY.definition: Required channels: BUILD_SOURCE, VALIDATION_SOURCE, QUERY_METADATA, QUERY_SOURCE_VERIFICATION
C20_COST_OBSERVABILITY.falsifier: aggregate count used to infer pruning mechanism
